scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run typecheck:workspace
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter integration-tests test
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:verify: pnpm run lint:verify && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.docs:dev: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter content dev
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter content build
